note: Which tenant and domain each governed project belongs to. Tenant = whose data and authority. Domain = Develop, Business, Personal or Phone. Each project has exactly one of each; a tenant can hold several domains. It lives in the installation rather than in a project, because a project's .projectops/ is writable by that project's own work. See docs/adr/ADR-T1-tenant-boundary.md.
provenance: Transcribed by the implementer (Claude) from the owner's Plan Mode decision of 2026-11-01, D2 'Agency apart, rest mine (Recommended)', recorded in docs/changes/delta_spec.md: agency-business holds the SEO agency and owner-personal holds ProjectOS, PolyGo and the others. PolyGo is listed as the second owner-personal project and its repository is not touched. Only the projects the Stage 2 exit proof needs are listed. An unlisted project is refused by name, and adding one is the action below.
trustBasis: MANUAL_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL, tamperProof false. Read from committed bytes only and validated whole before any match: a duplicate or wildcard refuses the entire file. Changing it is the P5 action tenant-registry-change, and the owner must have made its last commit; that check rests on a git name until signed commits exist. A transcription commit by the implementer is not the owner's commit, whatever name git records.
